overclaims: Morris and colleagues proposed an AGI classification framework on June 5, 2024, but the passage does not adopt that framework as its test
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, conditions and the not_applicable/open_horizon/not_adjudicable outcome all match. The rationale gets a date wrong: the arXiv page shows the framework was first submitted 4 Nov 2023. 5 Jun 2024 is only the v4 revision date. Suggested fix: 'a version of the framework available June 5, 2024'. Minor: the interpretation mentions 'screening examples' that the payload never introduces, and the proposition drops 'current' before 'neural networks'.
